about: The matchday intro's one tempo map, read by the page (intro.js, bundled) and the music (tools/intro_synth.py). 96 BPM in 4/4: a beat is 0.625 s, a bar 2.5 s. Times in seconds from the first frame.

shots.what: night sky, stars drifting; a footballer and a ball drawn in stars, a star a note
the camera tilts down through the floodlights' glare into the stadium bowl
the walk-out: silhouettes walking up the tunnel into the light
low angle up at a floodlight mast, its lamps blazing
long lens along the stand, camera flashes
grass-level slow motion: the striker's last strides
the strike: the ball leaves the boot trailing light
close: boot through the ball, the grass spraying
behind the ball as it streaks across the ground
the goalkeeper's dive in silhouette against the lights
from behind the goal: the net ripples
the floodlight banks blaze on, bank by bank
the striker, low angle, rim-lit
high over the bowl, circling, flashes
the goalkeeper set, the lights behind
boot and ball again, closer
the ball streaks past the lens
the walk-out, closer
spinning down over the centre circle
the ball flies up into the night and becomes a star
the star bursts; the stars gather into the trophy's outline; the trophy forms and turns
Whitebrook Road Sports, MATCHDAY, the two teams; then it fades to the channel
